title: Flexibility of the TRMT10C N-Terminal Domain Helix Explored by Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
authors: Hoang, Gia Linh; Rossetti, Giulia; Tisne, Carine; Carloni, Paolo
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究TRMT10C蛋白N端螺旋的构象柔性，属于蛋白质结构计算问题，但对象为特定蛋白片段而非通用方法创新。
abstract: The human mitochondrial tRNA methyltransferase TRMT10C contains a 41-residue long positively charged alpha-helix in its N-terminal domain, interacting with tRNAs from the anticodon to the T-loops. Here, we investigated the flexibility of this N-terminal long alpha-helix using comparative molecular dynamics simulations in explicit solvent with three different force fields/water model combinations, alongside two helices of identical length but different sequences: a polyalanine helix and an AEEEKRK repeat helix. We also expanded our simulations to three additional helices belonging to the Trm10 family. Five independent 1-mus simulations were performed for each system. The human TRMT10C helix turned out to display heterogeneous dynamics, with a stable alpha-helical segment (residues 132-139) embedded within more flexible regions and this trend was also observed in the human Trm10 family members. This relatively rigid segment is more hydrophobic, whereas the remaining portion is enriched in charged residues and shows higher conformational variability. The rigid region corresponds to the portion interacting with the cavity formed by tRNA and TRMT10C N-terminal domain. Additional simulations using alternative force-field and water-model combinations supported the robustness of the overall flexibility ranking for the AEEEKRK repeat helix and the TRMT10C helix, but it gave force-field-dependent results for the structural dynamics of the polyalanine helix. Simulations of the N-terminal helices of other TRMT10C homologues revealed similar flexibility profiles, suggesting that the observed trends are generalizable across the family. Based on our results, we suggest that the human TRMT10C helix is tuned to combine localized rigidity to provide localized structural support that helps present the fragile mitochondrial tRNA to the maturation enzymes with overall flexibility for conformational adaptation, facilitating tRNA positioning and efficient catalysis.
abstract_zh: 人线粒体tRNA甲基转移酶TRMT10C在其N端结构域中含有一个由41个残基组成的带正电荷的α-螺旋，该螺旋与tRNA从反密码子环到T环区域相互作用。在此，我们通过使用三种不同力场/水模型组合的显式溶剂比较分子动力学模拟，研究了该N端长α-螺旋的柔韧性，同时比较了两种长度相同但序列不同的螺旋：多聚丙氨酸螺旋和AEEEKRK重复螺旋。我们还将模拟扩展至Trm10家族中另外三个螺旋。每个系统进行了五次独立的1微秒模拟。人TRMT10C螺旋表现出异质性动力学，其中包含一个稳定的α-螺旋片段（残基132-139），嵌入在更柔性的区域中，这一趋势在人类Trm10家族成员中同样观察到。该相对刚性的片段更为疏水，而其余部分富含带电残基并显示出更高的构象变异性。刚性区域对应于与tRNA和TRMT10C N端结构域形成的腔体相互作用的部位。使用替代力场和水模型组合的额外模拟支持了AEEEKRK重复螺旋和TRMT10C螺旋整体柔韧性排序的稳健性，但对于多聚丙氨酸螺旋的结构动力学则给出了依赖力场的结果。对其他TRMT10C同源物N端螺旋的模拟揭示了相似的柔韧性特征，表明观察到的趋势在该家族中具有普遍性。基于我们的结果，我们提出人TRMT10C螺旋被调节为结合局部刚性以提供局部结构支持，帮助将脆弱的线粒体tRNA呈递给成熟酶，同时具备整体柔韧性以适应构象变化，促进tRNA定位和高效催化。
